company.name: Sysdig
company.shortDescription: Sysdig is a cyber security company that offers a platform for detecting changes in risk with runtime insights to prevent cloud attacks.
company.description:
In the cloud, every second counts. Attacks move at warp speed, and security teams must protect the business without slowing it down. Sysdig stops cloud attacks in real time, instantly detecting changes in risk with runtime insights, a unique AI architecture, and open source Falco. Sysdig delivers live visibility by correlating signals across cloud workloads, identities, and services to uncover hidden attack paths. By knowing what is running, teams can prioritize the vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, permissions, and threats that matter most. From prevention to defense, Sysdig helps enterprises move faster and focus on what matters: innovation.

Sysdig. Secure Every Second.

aiResearchSummary.text: Sysdig is researching unified event processing and log management over multiple domains, focusing on receiving streaming event data from cloud managers and applications. They are also developing runtime filtering of computer system vulnerabilities, identifying and remediating active vulnerabilities in currently running assets. Additionally, Sysdig is advancing programmatic container monitoring by storing trace data in shared memory buffers between kernel and user space. These areas reflect their focus on cloud security powered by runtime insights.
